# Ruchita Nagar

> Ruchita Nagar (handle: ruchita-nagar) is a Senior Software Engineer, Full-Stack Developer and team lead based in Bengaluru, India, with 5+ years of experience delivering enterprise web applications across telecom, AI, and energy with React, Python, and Django. Currently at Tietoevry. MCA from NIT Tiruchirappalli (NIT Trichy).

## Experience

- Tietoevry - Senior Software Engineer (Apr 2026 - present): features for the NetCloud Manager (NCM) platform that manages private 5G/LTE networks (RAN configuration, SIM management, authentication, monitoring); leads a team of 4+ developers
- Dataworkz - Software Developer (Oct 2023 - Mar 2026): Agent Builder interfaces and workflow management for an enterprise AI platform in React; Python/Django/DRF backend services with authentication, RBAC, user management and payment integration; PubMed, Slack and Google Drive integrations
- Halliburton - Software Developer (Aug 2021 - Aug 2023): React components and REST API integrations for Assisted Horizon Interpretation (AHI) and Assisted Seismic Interpretation (ASI); performance optimization; Jest unit tests
